summary: All 23 SRanger requirements are implemented in 9 Java files (package sranger). One controller (SRangerController) with modes MOVING (initial), TURNING, FINAL; six transitions in step() plus the initial mode; Clock-based clockResetTime with a since-style guard. Seven points are flagged: three invented defaults, four design choices (one concerns the model's rounding of the 0.5 m threshold).

issues.title: Sensor default distance when no reading is available is 1000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires a 'large default value' when no IR reading is available but does not give the value.
issues.fix_directive: None needed unless the requirements fix a value; any value above OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD (0.5 m) satisfies SR-DM5. Negative or NaN readings passed to update() are treated as 'no reading' and also yield the default.

issues.title: Actuator reports 0.0 / 0.0 before any command
issues.raw: SR-DM6 says the Actuator stores the latest command but not what it reports before the first one.
issues.fix_directive: None needed; the controller issues Move(moveVel, 0) at power-up, so the default is only observable before the controller is constructed.

issues.title: clockResetTime starts at 0.0
issues.raw: SR-Var1 defines clockResetTime but not its initial value; it is only read in Turning, after Moving -> Turning has set it.
issues.fix_directive: None needed; the initial value never influences a transition.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning is triggered by obstacle AND guarded by obstacleDetected
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 says the transition fires when the obstacle event is received; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) is the guard on the same transition. Both were combined: trigger obstacle, condition obstacleDetected.
issues.fix_directive: If the guard is meant to replace the event (an autonomous transition), drop the instanceof test and conjoin no negations (Moving has no other guard-only branch).

issues.title: Turning branch order: endTask, then autonomous turnDurationElapsed, then tick && !turnDurationElapsed
issues.raw: SR-Beh5/6/7 give no priority. endTask is placed first as the stop override. The autonomous Turning -> Moving branch is placed above tick: a tick arrives every cycle, so a tick branch above it would starve Turning -> Moving in Java. The tick branch conjoins !turnDurationElapsed as the profile requires, so the model's transitions are disjoint.
issues.fix_directive: None needed unless the requirements give a different priority.

issues.title: Power-up Move(moveVel, 0) is issued in the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1 requires Move(moveVel, 0) on entering Moving, and SR-Beh1 makes Moving the initial mode, so the command is issued once at construction. The extracted model may or may not carry this as an action of the initial transition.
issues.fix_directive: If the model must show the initial entry action and the extractor does not lift it from the constructor, report it; do not move the call into step(), which would add a transition no requirement names.

issues.title: Clock is advanced by the framework; obstacleThreshold 0.5 rounds up to 1 in the model
issues.raw: Time is a Clock (field 'timer', since 'clock' is reserved) advanced by the system framework via advance(seconds), which makes the controller deterministic and testable. Separately, OBSTACLE_THRESHOLD = 0.5 m is kept in metres as SR-DM2 states; the model's constants interface rounds it up to 1, so the model's obstacleDetected guard reads distance() <= 1. The exact value matters to the guard in Java; the model over-approximates it.
issues.fix_directive: None in the Java; units were kept as the requirements give them rather than rescaled to avoid rounding.
